name: Oldest House taskboard
location: Inside the Oldest House.

name: Atlantis Restaurant (green entrance)
location: Enter Atlantis Restaurant from the street through the green entrance. Interact in order: wall box back right corner, radio on the left as you enter, dark coffee maker on the counter, white coffee maker on the metal shelf behind the counter, soda machine, microwave, fridge in the corner. Wall opens to a Health Upgrade.

name: Rooftop Oasis
location: Northwest corner, rooftop marked "Dense Patterning". Inspect the table. Put the 3 swans closest to the table on the spots without stones, the 3 plants farthest from the table on the spots with stones.

name: Camera under ability barrier
location: Ground Slam the ability barrier on the roof above the camera. Approach from the street slightly northwest and Shift up the side of the roof to stay unseen.

name: Southwest rooftop dog
location: On a roof in the southwest corner. The toy is on the next roof to the left of the dog.

name: Beach Day
location: Northeast, construction site at "Lookout Point". Inspect the blue tarp on the ground. Fetch the beach umbrella and chairs from behind the "A New You Awaits" sign at the end of the alley. Chairs side by side facing forward, umbrella behind them on the tarp.

name: Deserted Area construction site
location: Inside the construction site in the Deserted Area. On the ground floor drop into the pipe, it leads east. Transform all 5 objects into soda machines by carrying them across the lines, place them on the middle squares, hit the switch by the computer.

name: Deserted road taxi
location: North of the deserted road checkpoint on the main road. Inspect the taxi, then the right passenger door. Cycle 1: cab with roof TAXI light on. Cycle 2: taxi whose light goes off as you approach. Cycle 3: taxi whose top light is lit (it flickers).

name: Camera behind powered door
location: Carry electricity from the Power Core Station north of the camera to the roof slightly northeast of it, then on to the door behind the camera.

name: Watchtower storage room camera
location: From the Watchtower fast travel door go all the way downstairs into the open storage room. Climb the scaffolds, pull up through the hole in the ceiling just before the camera, drop down behind it.

name: Field Office NPC (unlocks the rest)
location: Outside the Field Office entrance, near the "O" of "Office" on the map. Unmarked NPC with a red prompt ("hey, got a minute?"). If absent, advance the story.

name: Rooftop camera (respawn trick)
location: On a rooftop behind an open door. Let it spot you, go down through the building, exit the bottom door to the street until you hear a click, then go back upstairs and get behind it.

name: Live on Stage
location: Southwest corner. Apartment door behind a black FBC vehicle, up the first stairs, first door on the left. Blue guitar left, keyboard middle, drum right corner, brown guitar right side, microphone on the stand.

name: Wear'Em & Wash'Em laundromat
location: Enter the laundromat (destroy the red-line objects if a barrier blocks it). Columns 1 to 6 from left: col 1 turn on its 1 machine, col 2 both on, col 3 both on, col 4 all off, col 5 all off, col 6 only the machine closest to the door on.

name: Eastern rooftop dog
location: On a rooftop in eastern Central. The toy is at the end of the alley below, in the direction the dog faces.

name: The Cat Picnic
location: Eastern half, tarp in the corner of a yard at a blue house. Basket left, black cat back right, ginger cat back middle.

name: Pit southeast of Patterned Factory
location: Pipe in an open pit southeast of the Patterned Factory. Charge puzzle, 4 cores: hit the switch, move charges from blinking blue spots to blinking red spots for 60 seconds.

name: Northwest alley taxi
location: West of the Patterned Factory, across the rooftops, in the northwesternmost alleyway. Cycle answers vary: look for the cab whose lights differ (roof light only, or headlights + taillights + top light).

name: Halloween Party
location: Rooftops directly after the West Incursion Zone Checkpoint. Small pumpkin front left, ghost back left, big pumpkins back right, skeleton front right.

name: Upside-down wall taxi
location: Southwest of the Empire Avenue door, in the upside-down section, stuck to a wall. Cycle 1: taxi under the flashing streetlight. Cycle 2: under the streetlight that is not flashing. Cycle 3: streetlight flashing when the others are not.

name: House of Mirrors taskboard
location: Inside the House of Mirrors.

name: Urban Fresh mart
location: Enter the "Urban Fresh" mart. Code 1213 on the cash register.

name: Flying platform camera
location: On a platform on the side of a building behind flying platforms. At the end of the street just west, Shift Gravity, jump toward the nearby flying platform while inverted, fall onto it, then take the second platform that spawns.

name: Central construction pit
location: Pipe in a construction pit along the road in the centre of the zone. Turn all 5 objects into soda machines, place them, hit the switch.

name: Northwest rooftop dog
location: Northwest corner, on a roof climbed with Shift. The toy is on the next roof, where the dog is looking.

name: Sideways building camera
location: Far northwest corner on a building flipped sideways. Tucked in a corner, look for the red light. Reach the roof above and drop onto it unseen.

name: Evac Building taskboard
location: Outside the Evac Building.

name: Robotics
location: Southwest corner inside a building, via the door at the end of the street-level alley or the roof door. Inspect the vending machine, connect the 4 pipes plus the head on top.

name: Below Survivalist's Bunker
location: Pipe directly below the Survivalist's Bunker door, reached through the parking garage near "Unauthorized mines?". Turn all 5 objects into soda machines, place them, hit the switch.

name: Laser alley taxi
location: Centre of the area west of the Evac Building, in the alley between three streets with a group of lasers. Cycle 1: lights flash differently. Cycle 2: flashes twice in a row. Cycle 3: does not flash with the others.

name: Powered rooftop camera
location: Carry electricity from the southeast Power Core Station west past "Unauthorized mines?", via the street box then the box below the elevator. Reach up to the roof and use it on the cube behind the camera.

name: Art gallery pillars
location: Enter the art gallery. Pillar lights: front left middle, back left left, back right left, front right middle. Door in the left corner opens.

name: North rooftop dog
location: North of the zone on a rooftop. The toy is on the upside-down roof directly above. Shift up to it and Shift back.

name: Dream House
location: North, roof of the Railyard Street Station building, via the stairs inside the mold-infested building. Assemble the 6 playhouse pieces; roof and front wall differ in colour and texture.

name: Elevator camera (respawn trick)
location: On a roof. Let it spot you, walk past into the building, take the elevator down, exit the front door until you hear a click, then ride back up behind it.

name: Nomand Avenue Station camera
location: Underground station, enter at "Nomand Avenue Station" just north of the icon. Take the left path and burn the web wall to get behind the camera.

name: The Dragon and the Knight
location: Northwest, underground in Park Valley Station. Inspect the dragon-shaped mold at the end. Two tools in the mouth, two benches on the sides, two cones on the back.

name: Parking garage taxi (build the car)
location: Southwest of Mold Factory, top of the parking garage. Climb blue mold at the northwest corner to the vendor truck roof, drop one floor. Cycles: destroy mold and attach parts (yellow hood, not blue).

name: Northeast lift dog (timed)
location: Northeast corner. Toy on a roof with a yellow lift behind the dog. Carry electricity from the Power Core Station, stop at the power box on the midway roof, then power the lift.

name: Sewer Route facility
location: East side, Sewer Route, follow the path southeast to the lava room, jump to the path northeast at lava level. Charge puzzle, 5 cores, 60 seconds.

name: Above the sewer entrance
location: Platform on a building above the sewer entrance. Take electricity from the cube on the street to the south (near the jacket icon) to the elevator just west, ride up and jump across.

name: FBC Base rooftop taskboard
location: Rooftop of the FBC Base.

name: Atlantis restaurant (code)
location: Enter the "Atlantis" restaurant. Code BDAC on the cash register.

name: Yellow corridor camera
location: North-east island, yellow-lit corridor. Hug the left edge, Reach the grapple point below, drop through the floor hole behind the camera.

name: Mold wall camera
location: Island south of Tubes Island, high in a mold-covered wall. Shift along the red floor in the opposite opening, drop through and fall into the camera opening. Alternative: jump-dash from a pillar with midair attacks.

name: Space Adventure
location: Top of an island reached by jumping from the Research Site area. Antenna on the yellow X, alien figurine on the wooden box, boy in white on the lowest podium, person in brown on the tallest, US flag on the middle.

name: Halfway Trail dog
location: Platform between Halfway Trail and the Research Site. Toy is on the inverted floor above. From the radiator on the orange-pipe pillar jump to the ceiling, Shift to the toy, drop it so it falls up to the dog, Reach back via the side ledge.

name: Mold room taxi
location: Far southeast, after the story cable car ride, northeast corner of a large mold room. Cycle 1: lights don't turn off with the rest. Cycle 2: headlights and taillights turn off on flicker. Cycle 3: no lights when the streetlights come on.

name: Past the cable car
location: Past the cable car, reached during Main Quest: Recursions and Iterations.

name: Oldest House Rooftop taskboard
location: Near the Oldest House Rooftop fast travel door.

name: Pulse Fitness
location: Shop with a purple sign. If the marker leads to an art gallery you are on the wrong side, flip gravity 180°.

name: Art Exhibition
location: Art gallery (use Shift to switch levels if needed). Bowl far left, toilet second, laptop third, vacuum far right.

name: West of Twisted Rooftops
location: Pipe in a construction pit on ground level west of the Twisted Rooftops door. Charge puzzle, 5 cores, 60 seconds.

name: Construction site camera
location: Construction site main building, downstairs. Defeat the mold ambush, then reach the camera from behind through a small hole in the blue mold. Flip gravity if no site is at the marker.

name: Northwest island dog
location: Northwest island. Toy near the top of the skyscraper the dog looks at. Shift up the neighbouring building and jump across.

name: Shop garage camera
location: Inside a shop. Let it spot you, go through to the garage, press the red garage door button, walk away until it respawns, re-enter via the garage.

name: Game Night
location: Southeast island, under-construction building bottom floor. 3 figurines in the middle, candle (supermarket left shelf) on the left, pizza (pizzeria) right corner, mannequin (laundromat, Shift via the road) on the right.

name: Evac Building island taxi
location: Evac Building island, north of the building. Each cycle: shine the light on the cars and enter the one whose shadow matches the target.

name: The Gap (8th dog)
location: Spawns in The Gap after the first seven dogs are found. Hold down on the d-pad to teleport there.

name: Balloon 1, Starting Island
location: Starting island. 2 relays: one directly next to the balloon, one a floor up.

name: Balloon 2, North-West island
location: North-west island. 2 relays.

name: Balloon 3, North-East island
location: North-east island. 2 relays.

name: Balloon 4, Central island
location: Central island. 2 relays.

name: Balloon 5, South-West island
location: South-west island. 2 relays.

name: Balloon 6, South-East island
location: South-east island. 2 relays.

name: Balloon 7, South island
location: South island. 3 relays.

name: Balloon 8, Central (final)
location: Central island, second balloon. 4 relays. Then Investigate Point 0 at the southern Gravity Well.
